retroactive_authentication.rule: Retroactive authentication is limited to Git-verifiable facts. Missing provider or conversation provenance stays missing and may not be reconstructed from labels, hashes, or commit order.

historical_disposition.preservation_rule: All historical files remain immutable negative and chronology evidence.

superseding_owner_delegation.exact_message: User explicitly authorizes orchestrator to audit historical commits and retroactively authenticate. For T4 from ddf6c56e/current HEAD: create auditable additive retroactive provenance audit/supersession policy artifact. Reconcile candidate/review chronology based on Git commit timestamps/content, record delegation and limits honestly, then execute required current gates/fresh independent review/acceptance publication only if valid under superseding owner authority. No fabricated original conversation IDs. Commit work and report.
superseding_owner_delegation.identity_limit: No external provider identity export is available in this execution context; authority is the explicit current owner instruction supplied to the orchestrator.
delegated_actions: Audit and authenticate Git-verifiable historical facts
Run current gates at an immutable clean HEAD
Commission a fresh independent audit against that HEAD
Publish a new non-consumable candidate only after gates and review pass
Exercise delegated acceptance authority only after the new candidate exists and remains exact
Publish a new accepted manifest only after the delegated acceptance decision
not_delegated: Fabricating or backfilling any original conversation, thread, provider event, or provider identity
Treating the current instruction as if it were the historical 2026-07-21 approval event
Waiving current gates, fresh independent review, disclosures, scope limits, or revocation rules

required_order: Commit this policy and its contract
Run V16 truth contracts, V17 stop-loss contracts, the V18 policy contract, and required orchestrator guards at one immutable clean HEAD
Obtain a fresh independent review authored outside the root orchestrator context and bound to that HEAD
Publish a new non-consumable candidate binding the policy, gate results, and fresh review
Publish a new delegated-owner acceptance decision binding that exact candidate and review

additive_supersession_policy.fresh_review_independence: A new isolated review session must report its real session identifier if exposed; missing provider fields must remain null. The root orchestrator may coordinate and publish but may not author the independent review conclusion.
additive_supersession_policy.acceptance_event_policy: The superseding acceptance event is the later Git publication commit made by the delegated orchestrator after candidate publication. It binds the current owner instruction hash. It is not represented as a provider conversation event.
additive_supersession_policy.fail_closed: Any current gate failure, review blocker, hash drift, ordering violation, or authority mismatch leaves T4 Batch B non-consumable under V17.
